# A Go package gets no array operator and no reduction method from the
# tuple/SIMD rule: element-wise operators stay ordinary Go errors and no
# archsimd rewrite happens.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd

cd m
! logos build ./...
stderr 'operator \+ not defined'
! stderr 'archsimd'
! go build ./...
stderr 'operator \+ not defined'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/simdplaingo

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

func main() {
	var a, b [4]float64
	c := a + b
	_ = c
	_ = a.sum()
}
